text.en:
Today you learn to compare two things.
This bag is lighter.
It means: it weighs less.
This room is warmer.
It means: it is more warm.

Short word: add er.
light, lighter. warm, warmer.
To say which is more, add than.
Tea is cheaper than coffee here.
Long word: put more before it.
The map is more useful than the list.

You will pick the right way to compare.
Short word? Add er.
Long word? Say more first.
Then add than and the other thing.
Her bag is lighter than mine.
